title: Legislative Council Brief: New Capital Investment Entrant Scheme (File Ref: ASST/3/1/8/2/1C)
contains: Legislative Council Brief of 19 Dec 2023 on the New CIES: eligibility (age 18+, eligible nationalities, net assets of HK$30m for two years, no adverse record), minimum investment HK$30m (HK$27m permissible assets incl. non-residential real estate capped at HK$10m and certificates of deposit capped at 10%, plus HK$3m in the CIES Investment Portfolio), portfolio maintenance rules, procedure (InvestHK then ImmD; visitor entry up to 180 days to invest; 24-month then 3-year stays; permanent residence after 7 years), buyer's and new residential stamp duty suspension for applicants, implications, planned launch mid-2024. No application statistics. Investment thresholds, Exco approval and the Budget announcement were already recorded; this pass adds the net-asset requirement as a rule row (caps noted in it).

title: 2023 Budget Address (Prime Minister and Minister of Finance)
contains: 2023 Budget Address of the Prime Minister and Minister of Finance (December 2022, 44 pages). title: 2024 Budget Address (Prime Minister and Minister of Finance)
contains: 2024 Budget Address (13 Dec 2023, 62 pages). Programme content: the first CBI dividend (paid for the first time in the programme's history; about 17,500 people reached in its inaugural round; paid to Social Security contributors); 2022 non-tax revenue 54.9% above budget mainly because of CBI proceeds (no CBI amount); CBI section (paras 51-53): real estate option minimum US$400,000, mandatory applicant interviews and the Sustainable Island State Contribution introduced, enhanced due diligence; medium-term plan to reduce reliance on CBI revenue and to explore saving part of it in a dedicated fund. title: 2025 Budget Address (Prime Minister and Minister of Finance)

title: 2026 Budget Address (Prime Minister and Minister of Finance)

title: Canada accords partial visa waiver to citizens of St. Kitts and Nevis
contains: SKNIS relay of a Prime Minister's Office statement (6 June 2023): Canada partially lifts the visa requirement imposed on St Kitts and Nevis nationals in 2014; those who held a Canadian visa in the past ten years or hold a current US non-immigrant visa can apply for an eTA; others still need a visa. Already recorded as a visa_access event from this source; no numbers about the programme (the ten-year look-back is a condition, not a statistic).

title: New Citizenship by Investment regulations envisage a professional Board of Governors to be appointed effective January 1, 2023

No programme numbers (prices, fees, counts or money). The address itself (linked CBI.pdf) is a separate stored source (kna-ciu-address-2022-12).

title: State of the Citizenship by Investment Programme Speech by Prime Minister Hon. Dr. Terrance Drew
contains: Prime Minister's 'State of the CBI' speech of 17 Oct 2024: CBI revenue to the Federal Government 2019-2023 and Jan-Sep 2024 (already recorded); CBI said to have contributed 60-70 percent of Federal revenue when the government took office (Aug 2022); reform timeline (first investigation report Oct 2022, Dubai announcement 1 Dec 2022, new regulations by 23 Dec 2022, US-Caribbean roundtable Feb 2023, minimum raised to US$250,000 by July 2023, regional MoA March 2024); 'Prison Project' claim; list of planned projects (one, a new Basseterre High School, said to be CBI-funded, no amount). title: Saint Christopher and Nevis Citizenship by Substantial Investment (Amendment) Regulations, 2026 (S.R.O. No. 1 of 2026)
contains: S.R.O. 1 of 2026 (16 Jan 2026): new definition of dependant (unmarried children 18-29 substantially supported) and a replacement regulation 26 setting post approval-in-principle application fees: US$25,000 per main applicant or family of up to four, US$25,000 per additional dependant under 18, US$50,000 per additional dependant 18+, US$30,000 to add a spouse/dependant after approval-in-principle, US$7,500 per child under 3 born after citizenship; the Public Benefit fee is deducted from the US$250,000. All fee lines now recorded; event already recorded.

title: Saint Christopher and Nevis Citizenship by Substantial Investment Regulations, 2024 (S.R.O. No. 20 of 2024)
